description:
[Game reference] World event timers: Cargo Ship, Patrol Heli, Chinook, Bradley, airdrops, satellite, Deep Sea. Each event's `every` (in-game hours and the real-time equivalent with the default day length), its `facts`
(durations, crates, hack timer...), the `convars` that control it and `links`. `clan_score`: points per clan event.
Vanilla defaults; servers can change them. Intervals are in-game hours with real-time equivalents for the default day length; vanilla defaults. Link https://rust.wiki/events.
name: get_event_timers
title: World event timers: Cargo Ship, Patrol Heli, Chinook, Bradley, airdrops, satellite, Deep Sea
